artworks.title: The Industrious 'Prentice Lord-Mayor of London
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a parade scene in a city setting. The image features a lively street with a procession moving through it. The buildings are tall with many windows revealing small figures inside. At the center is an elaborate carriage surrounded by a crowd. Numerous flags and banners are held high in the scene. The illustration is detailed with clear lines, providing depth and perspective through the architecture and people.

artworks.title: Southwark Fair
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bustling fair with various scenes of activity and entertainment. The scene depicts a lively fairground filled with people engaged in different activities. There are stages with entertainers, animals, and various acts. Stalls are set up, and there is a feeling of chaos throughout the image. In the foreground, individuals are playing musical instruments, engaging in conversations, or attending to their booths. The architecture includes detailed facades and wooden structures, with signs and flags adding to the festive atmosphere. The engraving showcases a vivid depiction of societal interactions, each corner filled with intricate narrative details portraying the vibrancy and disorder of a busy fair.

artworks.title: The Gate of Calais, or The Roast Beef of Old England
artworks.description: This is a painting of a scene at an old city gate with various characters engaged in different activities. The image depicts a group of figures in a historical setting with an archway, coats of arms, and a portcullis. To the left, there are people seated, holding meat and a drink. In the center, several figures are in conversation or confrontation, one holding a large cut of meat. To the right, a man is resting on the ground with a pot. The style is reminiscent of William Hogarth, known for moralistic and satirical themes. The image portrays a contrast between wealth and poverty with detailed characters and setting.

artworks.title: Garrick in the Role of Richard III
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper mounted on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed within platemark): 41.5 × 52 cm (16 5/16 × 20 1/2 in.)
mount: 46.4 × 63 cm (18 1/4 × 24 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man sitting on the edge of a bed or couch, draped in fabric. He leans back with one arm extended forward. His facial expression is intense, with wide eyes and subtle lines on his forehead. He has short, curly hair and wears elaborate period clothing, including a fur-trimmed robe, a detailed doublet, and stockings. He wears a medallion on a chain around his neck. Nearby, a crown and a dagger can be seen. The room is ornately decorated with carvings and drapery. In the background, a crucifix is mounted on the wall. Through an open space, distant tents and a small bonfire against a cloudy sky are visible.

artworks.title: The Bruiser
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bear with a frothy mug and a dog below, surrounded by various items. The illustration depicts a bear holding a foamy tankard while emerging from an oval frame. The bear wears frilled clothing around its neck and is artistically anthropomorphized. Below the bear, there is a dog sitting obediently. The foreground contains a painter's palette and brushes, several books stacked upon one another, and a small tankard. The background features draped fabric. The image includes a poem underneath.

artworks.title: France
artworks.description: This painting features a chaotic scene with soldiers and religious figures in a coastal setting. It is in the style of William Hogarth. The composition includes soldiers in 18th-century attire wielding swords and flintlock guns, appearing to be embarking on a campaign from a brick building archway. A clergyman holds a flag marked with the word "VENGEANCE." Symbolic objects like a cross and a rack are visible on a nearby cart. Other soldiers head towards a ship docked at the harbor. The background shows the shoreline, cliffs, and another ship. The scene may offer a satirical commentary on political or religious tensions. The etching style highlights fine lines and character expressions, adding depth to the tableau.

artworks.title: England
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene portraying British soldiers and civilians. The illustration shows soldiers and civilians interacting with a caricatured figure. In the foreground, a soldier rests on a barrel, while others are gathered around a table with drinking vessels. The background features a sign for 'Duke of Cumberland' above a tavern entrance, with soldiers seen drilling in the distance. The elaborate costumes, exaggerated expressions, and narrative suggest a satirical tone, typical of this style of art.

artworks.title: The Cockpit
artworks.description: This is a painting of a chaotic scene at a cockfight arena. The full composition is densely packed with animated expressions and detailed figures that capture the frenzied excitement of the crowd watching a cockfight. The viewer's attention is drawn to the two birds in the center of the ring, while the audience surrounding them display a wide range of emotions, from intense focus to animated gesturing. Several individuals are seen leaning over the edge, eagerly watching or placing bets. The surrounding area includes various textures and patterns, such as brickwork and numerous hats worn by the crowd.

artworks.title: Strolling Actresses Dressing in a Barn
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a cluttered scene set in an attic. The illustration is densely packed with various elements such as furniture, clothing, musical instruments, and a spinning wheel. The scene features characters interacting with each other, surrounded by objects. The attic has a high, sloped ceiling with exposed beams and a dragon-like creature carved into the woodwork. The drawing uses intricate details and a black and white color scheme.

artworks.title: Hudibras and the Lawyer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene in an ornate library. There is a man gesturing to another man in a grand chair, while two other men are writing at a cluttered table. A statue with scales is next to the desk. Several women and two dogs are in the background. The walls are panelled and there are many books on high shelves.

artworks.title: Hudibras beats Sidrophel and his man Whacum
artworks.description: The image shows a room with various objects and activities. A skeleton, a globe, a table with astrological charts, dried animals, a group of people, an owl, and a housecat are part of the scene.

artworks.title: Analysis of Beauty: pl.1
artworks.description: The image contains rectangular and square panels, alongside curved and straight lines that intersect and overlap. Human figures are present, some alive and others sculpted, resembling classical sculptures and figures from art history. Various shapes like columns, leaves, and curls are interspersed, along with objects like books, a painter's easel, and a drafting compass. Smaller sketches include facial profiles, geometric patterns, and ornamental designs.

artworks.title: Analysis of Beauty: pl.2
artworks.description:
This is a drawing of a dance taking place in an opulent interior space. The scene shows a large room with ornate walls adorned with portraits and illuminated by candle sconces. Elegantly dressed individuals are engaged in a formal dance. The central focus is a prominently dressed figure leading the dance with graceful movement, surrounded by others displaying joyful expressions and seeming immersed in the dance. 

The border of the drawing is decorated with various smaller illustrations resembling elements of an art study or catalog, including swirls, head and face profiles, different hat styles, and anatomical features like eyes, noses, or ears, all meticulously numbered for reference. The style suggests a detailed and organized approach, possibly with a satirical or educational intent, as it combines elements of social illustration and scientific analysis.

artworks.title: The Distressed Poet
artworks.description: This is an engraving of an interior scene. The image shows a detailed and richly furnished domestic environment, characterized by disorder and clutter. A woman sits in a chair to the left, sewing or mending a garment, while a man in work clothes appears to be talking to her. In the background, a fireplace is adorned with decorative plates, and an animal is curled up in front of it. On the right side, another man is seated at a cluttered desk surrounded by books and papers. The beams of the ceiling and wooden floorboards add authenticity to the 18th-century interior depiction.

artworks.title: The Enraged Musician
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic street scene with various figures making noise. The image captures a bustling street with a cacophony of activities. At the center, an individual looks out of an upper window, plugging their ears. Below, a gathering of people and animals create a lively, noisy environment. There are musical instruments being played, a person carrying a large drum on their head, and a child with a hoop. Street sellers and market activities add to the busy scene. The architectural elements, such as old-style buildings and a church spire in the background, indicate an urban setting. The title is "The Enraged Musician".

artworks.title: Credulity, Superstition, and Fanaticism
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a crowded room during a religious or spiritual gathering. A preacher is at the center of the scene, gesturing upwards and holding a small figure. Behind him, a demon and an angel are shown. The crowd below shows a range of reactions, from distress to enthusiasm or skepticism. The image is full of symbolism and exaggerated expressions. The style resembles that of William Hogarth, known for satirical engravings. The title at the bottom is "Credulity, Superstition, and Fanaticism. A Medley."

artworks.title: Beer Street
artworks.description: The image depicts a bustling street scene from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon is high in the composition, showing the tops of buildings and the sky with a few clouds. The street is filled with people engaged in various activities. On the left, a painter is painting a shop sign on a ledge, while two men relax below him. In the center, workers are carrying a barrel. In the distance, a church spire rises above the rooftops. The style includes detailed line work, rendering the scene with depth. The color palette is monochrome, using shades of sepia or browns, typical of an engraving.

artworks.title: The South Sea Scheme
artworks.description: The image shows a crowded and chaotic scene with various activities and symbolic imagery. There is a large wheel ride at the center, with figures on horseback riding it. Surrounding the ride is a detailed street scene with people engaging in different actions. On the left, there is a shop with a sign reading "Stockjobbing" office. At the bottom right, text panels with satirical verses critique society and commerce. The artwork is depicted in a high contrast, black and white etching style.

artworks.title: The Lottery
artworks.description: This is a detailed drawing of an allegorical scene depicting a lottery. Various classical and mythological elements are present, with figures symbolizing abstract concepts engaged in activities related to the lottery. The central scene features a pedestal with figures representing symbolic identities like National Credit and Justice. Surrounding this central scene are other figures, including Apollo and Britannia, in neoclassical attire. The setting includes large lottery wheels and onlookers depicted with wings or classical robes. Architectural elements such as columns and drapery frame the illustration, enhancing its theatrical feel. Various metaphoric activities are annotated at the bottom, signifying aspects like Fortune drawing blanks and prizes, Suspension by Hope and Fear, and Good Luck seized by Pleasure and Folly. The drawing is packed with narrative motifs depicting fate, chance, and human endeavor within a richly engraved frame reminiscent of classical allegories.

artworks.title: Paul before Felix
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical courtroom scene. The image shows a group assembled in a grand architectural interior, with a figure in chains addressing a seated figure on a prominent seat. The setting includes a high ceiling with columns and drapery. To the left, a soldier stands with a spear, while other figures are observing or listening intently. Shadows and expressions enhance the tension and introspection of the scene. The detailed lines and shading suggest depth and texture, emphasizing the solemnity and gravity of the scene.

artworks.title: Paul before Felix Burlesqued
artworks.description: This is a painting of a courtroom scene with various figures and symbolic imagery. The composition includes a figure at a podium speaking to a seated crowd, light streaming in from above, a judge-like figure on the left, and a small creature at the bottom. Various characters are present, such as wise men, archers, a woman with scales, and a figure with bound wings. In the background, there is a walled area with barrels and a person at a window. The painting has a satirical tone and features dramatic contrast and shadowing typical of the style of William Hogarth.

artworks.title: Simon Lord Lovat
artworks.description: The image shows a seated man from the upper thigh to the head. He is positioned in a chair, leaning slightly with his hands clasped in his lap. The man's features include a chubby face with prominent cheeks, a furrowed brow, and a wry expression. His hair is curly and swept back. He is dressed in an elaborate coat with large buttons, a ruffled shirt cuff, breeches, and knee-length boots with buckles. Surrounding him is an ornately carved wooden chair with an exaggerated backrest. To his side, a table holds an open book. The background features diagonal lines.
